method.observation: Daily 1 km HYRAS area means (millimetres), accumulated from the first day of the month.
method.forecast: Hourly ensemble precipitation (mm) summed to HYRAS 06–06 UTC days per member and support point, then accumulated.
method.gap_policy: No zero-filling and no forecasting across unavailable days between the last observation and first model day.
method.reference: 1991-2020 regional daily precipitation climatology to be added separately.
